description: Paid $0.05 per call: Indonesian national public holidays and joint-leave days for a year the government calendar publishes (2021-2027) — dates, Indonesian and English names, and how many days away each one is. A year outside that window is refused with a machine-readable reason, not billed.

upcoming.description: true = only holidays today or later.

year.description: Calendar year, 2021-2027. Defaults to the current year.
